goal: Rust-own fd arena allocation failure routing: non-strict failure uses uncached host fallback, strict failure continues to cached fallback handling, and allocation failure latches cache-full state for later requests.

semantics: current C returns NULL from cuda_model_arena_alloc after a device allocation failure and latches g_model_cache_full so later fd requests do not retry arena allocation
cuda_model_range_ptr_from_fd converts arena failure into an uncached host pointer when DS4_CUDA_STRICT_WEIGHT_CACHE is absent
with DS4_CUDA_STRICT_WEIGHT_CACHE present, arena failure returns NULL from the fd path and lets later registration or device-copy fallback handle the range
raw byte-budget exhaustion remains a host fallback independently from strict mode; the aligned arena reservation check follows existing-arena reuse

implementation.selection_path: AbiFdArenaUpload now distinguishes raw BudgetFallback from ArenaFallback, tracks cache_full across requests until model replacement or cleanup, and maps ArenaFallback to host bytes only when strict fd caching is not selected
implementation.allocation_path: fd arenas allocate uninitialized device bytes through cuda-oxide before staged writes, preserving a direct allocation-failure branch instead of coupling it to zero-fill initialization
implementation.live_boundary: the linked consumer interposes cuMemAllocAsync only for 256 MiB fd arena allocations and interposes host registration; it observes non-strict host fallback, strict cached device-copy continuation, and no second arena allocation attempt
implementation.remaining_policy_boundary: aligned-reservation routing is source-backed but not separately forced live; staging allocation/read/copy failure selection, q8/f16 hooks, remaining graph compute exports, and route promotion stay pending

integration_risks: the live Rust staticlib uses cuda-oxide driver allocation, so the consumer interposes cuMemAllocAsync to observe the same arena-allocation failure policy that current C expresses through cudaMalloc
aligned arena-budget strict routing is preserved in source but is not separately forced by this live allocation-failure consumer
staging allocation/read/copy failure selection, q8/f16 hooks, production linker selection, and C CUDA removal remain pending
the generated embed object still produces an executable-stack linker warning before route promotion
